name: Prompt Confusion Phase 08
description: Relational conflict-detection benchmark with crossed strategy and setting directions, designed so conflict is not lexically decodable from raw text by construction.
goal: Replace family-locked prompt-confusion data with a relational benchmark where conflict is a property of the strategy-settings relationship rather than a property of any single text span.

outputs.notes: Stores the Phase 08 design note, workflow specs, and future dataset artifacts.
